name: Purifier Mask AA Support
description:
Ensure every breath you take is crisp and clean with the Purifier mask. It features a wide faceplate rimmed with a special synthetic rubber to provide an airtight fit, while two small lights on each side deliver a clear view ahead. 

The AA Support edition is sharp red, blue, and black. An Alliance Aid decal on the front guarantees that the filter is certified to purify the air of Molina Mold.
